QBS's website describes behavioral crisis-prevention (Safety-Care) training and consulting for schools and districts, matching OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' category and the Community Schools and Student Services Department
Directory listings in search results place QBS's corporate office at 49 Plain St, North Attleboro, MA (an earlier address; the company's site now lists Foxboro, a neighboring town)

profile.summary: QBS is a company that provides behavioral crisis prevention and de-escalation training, called Safety-Care, along with related behavioral consulting. It serves schools and school districts, healthcare, human services and applied behavior analysis organizations. The company says it was founded in 1997.
